statement.zh: 返回者每步可得；处处返回恰是每个过程不离开的区域都保留它自己的每个可能。保留每个可能不给返回，不合并在有限多配置之内沿运行给返回，合并不必失去可能。
statement.en: What returns can be had at every step; every configuration returns exactly where each region the process stays in keeps all its possibilities. Keeping every possibility does not give returning; merging nothing gives it along runs in finitely many configurations, and a merge may lose no possibility.

claim.zh: 对过程 P：配置 n 步之后可得（Branching.Reachable），指有 n 个动作的路径通向它；它返回（Branching.Returns），指从它的一步通向能再得到它之处；过程合并（Branching.Merges、Branching.Lossless），指两个不同的配置一步到同一处。在确定的律下每个都是 R6 的（law_reachable_iff、law_returns_iff、law_lossless_iff、law_merges_iff、law_keeps_iff）。不加前提：失去的可能保持失去（Branching.lost_stays）；返回的配置每步可得（Branching.Returns.reachable），所以处处返回则保留每个可能（keeps_of_returns）；保留每个可能恰是每个配置下一步可得（keeps_iff_fed）。返回的精确条件：配置恰在它自己的路径下一步能得到它时返回（returns_iff_fed_ahead）；每个配置都返回，恰在过程从不离开的每个区域都保留它自己的每个可能时（returns_iff_keepsWithin、returns_iff_fedWithin、keepsWithin_iff_fedWithin），不用有限性。只沿运行、在有限多配置中成立：不合并时运行的每个配置在运行上回来（Lossless.comes_back、Lossless.recurs），运行开始处的配置返回（Branching.Lossless.returns），沿运行从不下降的量保持不变（Branching.Lossless.no_rise），这样的量严格上升与不合并矛盾（Branching.rise_not_lossless，结论为 ¬ Lossless P，不给出 Merges 的见证），不合并而有不返回的配置需要开放（Branching.Lossless.unlisted）。见证：Transit 中每个配置能动、每个可能都保留，between 却从不返回（Transit.keeps_not_returns）；OneWay 合并 false 与 true，两者都返回，每个可能都保留（OneWay.merge_keeps）；Unfolding 的 Fork 不合并而其起点从不返回，因为其终点不能动，所以 Lossless.returns 需要运行（fork_lossless_not_returns）；合并后保持合并需要确定性（Determined.stays_merged；Coarse.meet_and_part）。不加前提。
claim.en: For a process P: a configuration can be had n steps on (Branching.Reachable) where some course of n moves leads to it; it returns (Branching.Returns) where a step from it leads to where it can be had again; a process merges (Branching.Merges, Branching.Lossless) where two distinct configurations step to one. Under a determined law each is R6's (law_reachable_iff, law_returns_iff, law_lossless_iff, law_merges_iff, law_keeps_iff). With no premise: a possibility lost stays lost (Branching.lost_stays); a configuration that returns can be had at every step (Branching.Returns.reachable), so where every configuration returns every possibility is kept (keeps_of_returns); every possibility is kept exactly where every configuration can be had at the next step (keeps_iff_fed). The exact condition for returning: a configuration returns exactly where its own course can have it at the next step (returns_iff_fed_ahead); every configuration returns exactly where every region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own (returns_iff_keepsWithin, returns_iff_fedWithin, keepsWithin_iff_fedWithin), with no finiteness used. Along runs, within finitely many configurations: where nothing merges every configuration of a run comes back on the run (Lossless.comes_back, Lossless.recurs), a configuration at which a run begins returns (Branching.Lossless.returns), a quantity nondecreasing along the run is constant (Branching.Lossless.no_rise), and a strict rise of such a quantity contradicts losslessness (Branching.rise_not_lossless, concluding ¬ Lossless P rather than supplying a witness of Merges), and merging nothing with a configuration that never returns needs openness (Branching.Lossless.unlisted). Witnesses: in Transit every configuration can move and every possibility is kept, yet between never returns (Transit.keeps_not_returns); OneWay merges false and true, both return, and every possibility is kept (OneWay.merge_keeps); Unfolding's Fork merges nothing and its origin never returns, its ends being unable to move, so Lossless.returns needs its run (fork_lossless_not_returns); merged stays merged needs determinacy (Determined.stays_merged; Coarse.meet_and_part). No premise.
